# Build Dashboard Component

Goal:
Implement or update one Dashboard V5 component.

Use Skills:
- life-os-vertical-slice
- life-os-design-taste
- life-os-browser-proof
- life-os-completion-gate

Read first:
- `AGENTS.md`
- `DESIGN.md`
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`
- `ACCESSIBILITY.md`
- `docs/design/dashboard-v5.md`
- `docs/design/design-tokens.md`
- `docs/design/component-system.md`

Rules:
- Keep P0/P1/P2/P3 hierarchy.
- Use existing tokens/components.
- Do not redesign the dashboard.
- Do not add libraries.
- Ensure keyboard/accessibility basics.

Output:
Erstellt / Geändert / Nicht geändert / Validierung / Offene Punkte / Risiken.
